issue: Seven JEI information descriptions remain Chinese after in-world zh_cn → en_us resource reload
native_cached_description: 制作导航：第二章「火符」；符纸取得后可在原配方书发现。
右键：瞄准落点周围4.5格一次600+攻击×3伤害，点燃8秒。
生存模式右键消耗一张。按 R 查配方，符纸按 U 查可制作的符箓。

jar_english_translation.jei.dynasty.talisman.single_use: Survival use consumes one. Press R for recipes, or U on talisman paper for available charms.
jar_english_translation.jei.dynasty.talisman.source.fire_talisma: Source: Chapter II, Fire Talisman. Obtain talisman paper to discover the original recipe.
jar_english_translation.jei.dynasty.talisman.use.fire_talisman: Use: one 600 + 3x attack hit within 4.5 blocks of the aim point, ignites for 8 seconds.
jar_english_translation.jei.dynasty.talisman.source.thunder_tali: Source: Chapter II, Thunder Talisman and the Edict build guide; no new use gate.
jar_english_translation.jei.dynasty.talisman.use.thunder_talisma: Use: one 800 + 4x attack hit within 5 blocks. Three bolts are visual; Slowness II for 8s and Weakness II for 5s.
jar_english_translation.jei.dynasty.talisman.source.wind_talisma: Optional Wind Talisman: press U on talisman paper for the original crafting recipe.
jar_english_translation.jei.dynasty.talisman.use.wind_talisman: Use: 200 + 2x attack and knockback around you; Speed III, Slow Falling and Jump Boost II for 45s.
jar_english_translation.jei.dynasty.talisman.source.stealth_tali: Optional Stealth Talisman: press U on talisman paper for the original crafting recipe.
jar_english_translation.jei.dynasty.talisman.use.stealth_talisma: Use: Invisibility, Speed II and Night Vision for 60s; clear current mob aggro within 16 blocks.
jar_english_translation.jei.dynasty.talisman.source.vajra_talism: Optional Vajra Talisman: press U on talisman paper for the original crafting recipe.
jar_english_translation.jei.dynasty.talisman.use.vajra_talisman: Use: Resistance III and Strength II for 15s, Fire Resistance for 60s. No healing.
jar_english_translation.jei.dynasty.talisman.source.soul_talisma: Optional Soul Talisman: press U on talisman paper for the original crafting recipe.
jar_english_translation.jei.dynasty.talisman.use.soul_talisman: Use: one 500 + 3x attack hit within 6 blocks; Blindness and Weakness II for 8s.
jar_english_translation.jei.dynasty.talisman.source.return_talis: Source: main journey, Prepare Your Return → Return Talisman. Prepare before departure.
jar_english_translation.jei.dynasty.talisman.use.return_talisman: Use: return to a safe spot near the Overworld shared spawn and clear harmful effects, not to your bed.

suspected_area: WorkshopJei.registerRecipes adds ingredient info; JEI captures translated descriptions at initial runtime creation; changing language reload does not reconstruct them. Hypothesis, not yet a code-level fix.
cold_english_start: PASS: all seven resolve English descriptions in run-03/cold-en-talismans-audit.json
initial_status: Confirmed live-language-switch issue; no production edits. Cold English startup works.

resolution.description: Seven original information recipes now retain translatable components through IJeiIngredientInfoRecipe instead of JEI addIngredientInfo flattening factory.
resolution.sequence: run06 cold zh→hot en→hot zh; 216/216; real cached wrapped text and native R/back/Escape/U; run07 cold English seven pages plus corrected bottom scrolling.
